sentences.text: Aparshakti Khurrana is an Indian Bollywood actor , RJ , and TV anchor .	TV anchor	TV anchor	RJ	Radio jockey
He is the younger brother of Ayushmann Khurrana who is a popular actor from B-Town .	Ayushmann Khurrana	Ayushmann Khurrana	B-Town	B-Town
Khurana made his Bollywood debut with Aamir Khan 's `` Dangal '' .	Aamir Khan	Aamir Khan	Dangal	Dangal (film)
He is currently hosting a show on discovery channel `` You Have Been Warned '' .
